title: Gal Jan
overview:
"An industry first! Rotoscope animation"

This is a technique in which subjects captured frame by frame from live-action footage are traced to create key drawings, and the animation is then produced from those drawings. The flowing movement of hair, the subtle timing of a blink, and more are rendered with a beauty you have never seen before.

This adult mahjong game brings that rotoscope technique to its female characters, so the women you face at the mahjong table move with lifelike animation.

- 1 player
- Rated X: for ages 18 and over

「業界初！ロトスコープアニメ」

実写映像から1コマずつ取り込んだ被写体をトレースして原画を起こし、その原画をもとにアニメーション画像を制作する手法です。髪の毛の流れる動き、微妙な瞬きのタイミングなど、今までに見たことのない美しさが表現されています。
